# 00000003075

**English.** Definition: Presentable ∞-categories: the theory of presentability. Conjecture: Presentable adjoint pairs: adjunctions between presentable categories are generated by small sets of objects, with the minimal cardinality of generation the density character of the object set. (presentable generation density character)

**中文。** 定义：可呈现（presentable）∞-范畴：可示性理论。猜想：可呈现的伴随对：可呈现范畴间的伴随由对象的小集生成且生成的极小基数为对象集的密度特征。（可呈现生成密度特征）
